import_flow.wallet_password_subtitle: Add an optional password if you want Spectra to ask for it before revealing this wallet's seed phrase later.
import_flow.wallet_password_success: This password will be required when showing the seed phrase for this wallet.
import_flow.watchAddressesSubtitle: Enter one or more wallet addresses, one per line.
import_flow.word_count_footer: Auto reads the length from your phrase. A fixed length refuses a longer phrase rather than cutting it short.
import_flow.wordlist_footer: Auto-detect reads the wordlist from your words. Choose one only if it picks the wrong list.

settings.aboutEthosLines:
Free and open source.
No data collected.
Decentralized software.
We don't have servers to process your data.
Self-custodial.
You are in charge of your own keys.
settings.aboutNarrativeParagraphs:
Your wallet data stays on your device unless you explicitly choose to share it. Spectra is designed so key material, watched addresses, and local transaction state remain under your control.

You keep control over recovery phrases and private keys at all times. The app is a client, not a custodian, and it should be understood as local wallet software that talks to chain infrastructure rather than a hosted account platform.
settings.aboutSubtitle: A self-custodial multi-chain wallet focused on local control, transparent network access, and minimal trust assumptions.
settings.buyExchangeNote: Exchanges hold what you buy in an account of theirs. To hold it yourself, withdraw to one of your Spectra addresses afterwards.
settings.buyListingNote: Listed alphabetically. Spectra is not affiliated with any of them and does not receive a fee.
settings.buyOnrampNote: On-ramps send what you buy straight to a wallet address you enter, so the coins arrive in Spectra without a second step.
settings.buyProvidersIntro: Two ways to turn cash into crypto. Availability, fees, identity checks, supported networks and regional coverage differ by provider — check before you pay.
settings.buyWarning: Spectra does not process purchases. Always double-check the wallet address, selected chain, and asset before paying, because crypto transfers are typically irreversible.
staking.broadcast_confirmation: Send this signed staking transaction to the selected nodes? Submission may change your on-chain position and incur the reviewed fee.
staking.build_explanation: Preparation checks your authority, current balances, fees and protocol limits. It accesses your wallet key but does not authorize or submit the transaction.
staking.delay_integer: Enter a whole number of seconds for the dissolve delay.
staking.delayed_reward_payout: Governance queues this maturity payout. It arrives after a delay, and governance modulation may change the final amount.
staking.dissolve_delay_help: Enter an explicit neuron dissolve delay. Review it carefully: unlocking starts only after you request dissolution.
staking.fee_deducted: The network fee is deducted from this amount.
staking.full_position_action: This action applies to the full eligible position. Current chain state is checked again before signing and submission.
staking.full_withdrawal: Leave the amount empty to withdraw all currently available funds.
staking.funding_completed: Original funding is confirmed. This review completes the remaining neuron setup.
staking.inputs_changed: Staking inputs changed. Prepare and review the transaction again.
staking.intro: Delegate, manage your positions, and review every transaction before signing and broadcasting.
staking.no_positions: No staking positions found for this wallet.
staking.no_validators: No matching validators. You can also enter a verified identifier directly.
staking.no_wallet: Import a wallet with an address on this network to manage staking.
staking.positions_not_loaded: Load your positions to see their current balances and available actions.
staking.repair_explanation: Core verifies the original funding and remaining governance steps. Review the recovery, sign it again, then broadcast it separately.
staking.review_before_signing: Confirm the action, target, lock period and fee before signing. Broadcast is a separate step.
staking.review_unavailable: The staking fee review is unavailable. Prepare a new transaction before signing.
staking.saved_review: This review is saved on this device. You can close it and resume the same transaction later.
staking.submission_pending: A node accepted the transaction. Network execution and confirmation are still being checked.
staking.watch_only: This wallet can display public positions. A signing wallet is needed to change them.
